_comment: Manual corrections applied after parsing Wikipedia. left/right = main candidates (exact names as listed).

AK-SEN.note: Top-four primary and ranked-choice general; a second, unrelated Dan Sullivan is also on the ballot.

_louisiana: Louisiana's House races are all-party primaries with several candidates per party. LA-05 and LA-06 had no market or polls by candidate, so the parser picked minor ones; left/right here are the leading Democrat and Republican in the Nov. 3 AP count (LA-05's runoff pair).

LA-01.note: All-party primary: every candidate, of any party, is on one ballot. If no one wins a majority, the top two meet in a December runoff.
